card.name: Linking words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words ("or", "in", "into") in dosing instructions. They follow a tablet or capsule being placed in liquid, or a recovery grade or time span.

modes.label: Placing tablet in liquid
modes.description: "in" or "into" right after a tablet or capsule in swallowing-difficulty instructions.
modes.example: Immerse gefitinib tablets<< in>> 4 to 8 ounces of water

modes.label: Grade or duration alternatives
modes.description: "or" joining a recovery grade, baseline, or time span in withhold or duration instructions.
modes.example: Withhold GAVRETO until recovery to baseline<< or>> Grade 0 or 1.
